segment: Seg 1: US-395 Jct to Ranger Station & Lower Gate
notable_features: Sweeping climb up lateral moraine; Mono Basin Scenic Visitor Center view to NE; Winter Closure Gate #1 at PM 3.5

segment: Seg 2: Lower Gate to Poole Plant Road Turnoff
notable_features: Descends slightly onto canyon bench then climbs; junction with Poole Power Plant Rd (FS 1N04) on right

segment: Seg 3: Poole Turnoff to Vista Point (Canyon Shelf Begin)
notable_features: Leaves canyon floor onto south-facing talus shelf; metal beam guardrail begins; wide gravel vista turnouts on right

segment: Seg 4: The Big Grade (Rockfall Netting & Cliff Cut)
notable_features: Iconic vertical granite & metamorphic cliff cut on left; sheer 350m drop to Poole Plant on right; wire-mesh rockfall drapery; tight blind curves
Sharp right-left S-bend at Ellery Dam crest; flat rock-bordered causeway along north shore of Ellery Lake (2893m)

segment: Seg 6: Ellery Lake to Saddlebag Lake Road Junction
notable_features: Climbs past Junction Campground and Tioga Pass Resort site to Saddlebag Lake Rd (FS 1N02) fork

segment: Seg 7: Tioga Lake Shoreline to Yosemite East Entrance
notable_features: Gentle subalpine roll along east shore of Tioga Lake; Dana Meadows boardwalk view; stone kiosk at Tioga Pass (3031.2m)

segment: South Box Edge to SR 120 W Junction
notable_features: 4-lane divided expressway descending past Mono Craters pumice flats; Test Station Rd intersection

segment: SR 120 W Junction through Lee Vining Town
notable_features: Narrows to 2 lanes + center turn lane (25 mph through Lee Vining); curves around bench above Visitor Center

segment: Lee Vining North to SR 167 / Lundy Lake Rd
notable_features: Hugs sheer Sierra fault scarp 15m above Mono Lake west shore; rockfall catchment ditch on west; Old Marina & DeChambeau turns

segment: Conway Summit South Grade (SR 167 to Conway Summit)
notable_features: 4-lane climbing grade (2 uphill, 2 downhill); wide sweeping horse-shoe curve; massive Conway Summit Vista turnout on east side

segment: Conway Summit to SR 270 (Bodie Rd) & North Box Edge
notable_features: Long straight descent past Virginia Lakes Rd turnoff (38.118N) and SR 270 Bodie Rd junction (38.1243N) into Bridgeport basin

segment: Paved Section (US-395 to Pavement End PM 9.8)
notable_features: Winds up narrow volcanic canyon of Cottonwood Creek; frost-heaved asphalt; open range cattle guards (4 total); no shoulders

segment: Gravel Section (Pavement End to Bodie Parking Lot)
notable_features: Severe washboard (corrugations 60-80 cm wavelength, 3-6 cm amplitude); loose decomposed granite and volcanic cobbles; dust plumes

segment: US-395 Junction to East World Box Edge
notable_features: Arrow-straight desert highway ('Pole Line Road') with rhythmic road dips for flash-flood washes; 65 mph speed limit

segment: US-395 Junction to Lundy Lake Dam & Resort
notable_features: Straight alluvial fan climb between moraines, then enters aspen tunnel alongside Mill Creek to Lundy Lake north shore
